title: Splash screen — choose the composition
question: Era pinned: 1950s–60s cookbook. World fixed (cream/navy/lime, engravings, one new display face for brand moments). This choice is the splash composition. The roll leads with the Recipe Card.

options.label: Recipe Card
options.lineage: the handwritten kitchen index card, 'From the kitchen of …'
options.thesis: The app introduces itself as a recipe card from its own box — the most personal object of the 1950s kitchen.
options.viewport: Cream ground; one centered vintage index card: navy header band with 'Nutrimero' lockup, script 'Home Baker' sitting on the card's ruled lines, tagline on the rule below, loaf mark stamped bottom-right. Loading dots render as pencil dots on the last rule.
options.risk: A card-on-ground composition uses less of the viewport than a full-bleed cover — the object must be exquisite or the screen reads sparse.

raised.raise: Color is rationed to the one thing that moves: lime appears only in the loading dots; everything else is navy ink on cream.

regions.label: ruled card · script 'Home Baker' + tagline on rules

options.label: Flour-Sack Print
options.lineage: two-color kitchen textile prints and printed flour sacking
options.thesis: The opening is a printed kitchen cloth — a repeating wheat print with the brand as its woven-in label.
options.viewport: Full-bleed repeating wheat-sprig print (navy + a lime accent sprig every nth repeat) on cream; centered circular label disc with double rule carrying the loaf mark, 'Nutrimero Home Baker' and the tagline; loading dots below the disc.
options.risk: A repeating pattern at phone scale flirts with wallpaper — the print must stay sparse and the label must dominate.

options.label: Split-Band Cover
options.lineage: mid-century cookbook covers with horizontal color bands
options.thesis: The app opens as its own book cover — masthead band, engraved plate, one thin lime rule.
options.viewport: Top: navy band with reversed 'Nutrimero' and script 'Home Baker'. Middle: cream field with the engraved sourdough plate centered, tagline beneath. A thin lime band as the printer's rule. Foot: colophon and loading dots.
options.risk: Closest to the category's default splash (logo band over image) — the band proportions and the engraving must carry the era or it reads generic.

regions.label: navy masthead · Nutrimero / script Home Baker
